subject: general
question: Which is an important electrical safety tip in a workshop?

options.text: If the device is functional, disregard the worn-out wires.
Ensuring that electrical equipment is properly grounded.
Operating a machine with wet hands
Using water to clean an electrical panel

solution:
The correct answer is __Ensuring that electrical equipment is properly grounded****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ensuring proper grounding of electrical equipment__ is a critical safety measure.
 
• Proper grounding prevents electric shocks and protects individuals working in the workshop.
 
• It ensures that stray currents, caused by faults, are safely diverted to the ground instead of causing harm.
 
• Worn-out wires or operating equipment with wet hands can increase the risk of electric shock or fire hazards.
 
• Water should never be used to clean electrical panels as it can lead to short circuits.
 
• Adhering to electrical safety guidelines is mandatory to ensure a safe working environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Workshop Electrical Safety Tips:**
 
 
• Always inspect tools and equipment before use for any damage or wear.
 
• Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as insulated gloves.
 
• Ensure circuit breakers and fuses are functioning correctly.
 
• Keep the workshop clean and free from clutter to avoid accidents.
